Use when breaking down complex projects, structuring information, planning multi-step workflows, or organizing any nested hierarchy. Supports 21 specialized patterns (WBS, GTD, Philosophy, Sales, Film, etc.) and exports to JSON, Markdown, and Mermaid diagrams.
